## Changes

- Update compatibility for Codex CLI 0.153.4.
- Keep unsent messages and attachments when `/refer` cannot load the referenced conversation.
- Keep diagnostic and recovery commands available when a saved thread cannot be restored.
- Fix Japanese and renamed file paths in diff views, and show trailing line break changes in Selection Rewrite.
- Prevent file links containing parent-directory segments from opening files outside the vault or inside its configuration directory.
